dependencies.label: Employee Health & Safety
dependencies.description: Dependency on maintaining workforce physical and psychological safety. Material across all sectors; especially acute in high-hazard industries where incidents result in fatalities, regulatory action, and reputational damage. UK HSE enforcement is active.
indicators: % of workforce covered by health & safety management system

dependencies.label: Process Safety & Operational Integrity
dependencies.description: Risk of major accident hazards in hazardous installations (refineries, chemical plants, mines). Distinct from occupational safety — process safety failures can cause catastrophic events affecting communities and the environment.
indicators: Unplanned operational downtime due to safety issues

dependencies.label: Workforce Diversity & Representation
dependencies.description: Dependency on a diverse workforce to access full talent pools, reflect customer bases, and avoid groupthink. UK legal obligations (Equality Act, gender pay gap reporting). Growing investor and regulator focus on ethnicity and disability disclosure.
indicators: % women in workforce, management, and board
DEI initiatives and targets in place

dependencies.label: Pay Equity & Fair Compensation
dependencies.description: Ensuring employees are paid equitably regardless of gender, ethnicity, or other protected characteristics. Pay equity gaps create legal liability, reputational risk, and talent attrition, and are increasingly subject to mandatory disclosure.
indicators: Gender pay gap (mean and median, UK mandatory)
Pay ratio: CEO to median worker
% of workforce on zero-hours or insecure contracts

dependencies.label: Labor Relations & Collective Bargaining
dependencies.description: Quality of relationships with trade unions and the workforce collectively. Poor labour relations lead to strikes, productivity loss, and reputational damage. UK union density varies by sector; recognition disputes are increasing.
indicators: % of workforce covered by collective bargaining agreements
Number of working days lost to industrial action

dependencies.label: Workforce Restructuring & Job Security
dependencies.description: Management of workforce reductions, site closures, and restructuring. Poorly managed restructuring creates legal liability, reputational damage, and community harm. Transition to low-carbon economy is driving large-scale retraining needs.
indicators: % of affected workers supported with retraining/outplacement

dependencies.label: Talent Recruitment, Retention & Engagement
dependencies.description: Dependency on attracting and retaining skilled employees. High turnover creates cost (recruitment, training) and capability gaps. Talent shortages are acute in technology, healthcare, engineering, and financial services in the UK.

dependencies.label: Skills Development & Training
dependencies.description: Investment in workforce capability development to maintain competitiveness, operational safety, and regulatory compliance. Critical where regulatory competence requirements exist (financial services, healthcare, engineering) or where technology is rapidly changing skills requirements.
indicators: Average training hours per employee per year
% of workforce with individual development plans

dependencies.label: Just Transition & Green Skills
dependencies.description: Workforce readiness for the low-carbon transition. Particularly material for high-carbon sectors where job profiles will change substantially. Includes reskilling workers in declining activities and building capacity in low-carbon alternatives.
indicators: % of high-carbon roles with reskilling pathways
Partnerships with educational institutions for transition skills

dependencies.label: Employee Mental Health & Wellbeing
dependencies.description: Dependency on a psychologically safe and healthy workforce. Poor mental health increases absenteeism, presenteeism, and turnover. UK employers face growing legal and social expectations to address workplace mental health.
indicators: Mental health support programmes in place
% of managers trained in mental health first aid

dependencies.label: Leadership Pipeline & Succession Planning
dependencies.description: Risk of leadership gaps from inadequate succession planning. Material for organisations with concentrated expertise, family or founder-controlled businesses, or where key-person dependency is high.
indicators: % of senior roles with identified successors

dependencies.label: Contractor, Agency & Gig Workforce Management
dependencies.description: Risks associated with use of contingent, agency, and gig workers including misclassification liability, quality control, health & safety responsibilities, and reputational risk from poor treatment of non-employee workers.
indicators: % of workforce that is contingent / agency / self-employed
